text: Please come to Florida and save us!!!! I grew up here and remember when the state was purple. When the magas came down to follow Trump they ruined the state. Everything is super expensive, housing skyrocketed out of control, wages are still low, education is in the gutter, racism and discrimination is sky high. I literally saw them take over the beach towns and drive around in golf karts with confederate flags! Then they gerrymandered the state and ruined it even more. We have David Jolly running for governor and Alexander Vindman running for senator, they are both a little behind, but they are within the margin of error and could use a boost to push them into a winning position!!! We could also get a Dem AG! Please help us flip the state blue! 🩵💙🩵💙🩵💙🩵 PS: I suggest many ads in SPANISH! To get the Latino voters (I’m Latina). All they get is lies from the right. Also reach out to the university towns, Gen Z is quickly turning blue. I would also love videos from Tyler’s group in Spanish or with some subtitles in Spanish and Portuguese so Latinos can read them and understand better what the truth is.
